Apple Spaces Prototype

TAMU Product Initiative Deliverable · Executive Summary

The Core Pivot (Hangout Wedge)

Students’ biggest pains happen before the hangout (changing availability, deciding what to do, splitting costs). Spaces starts at the planning stage in Messages and carries seamlessly into the living room.

MVP Scope Boundaries:

  • Hardware Anchor: iPhone + 1 Shared Apple TV in the living room.
  • Location Privacy: Defaults to OFF. Users tap "I'm here" check-in if preferred.
  • Cross-Platform Strategy: Android friends access a web link (`spaces.apple.com/join/...`) for plans, time votes, and cost split without being excluded.
  • Teardown: True ephemerality—all permissions, TV access, and location revoke on exit.

Team Authors:
